verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents a Reusable KYC feature that lets applicants reuse data from previous verifications. It also lets clients sign agreements with other Sumsub clients to share verification data and complete their own checks without a full re-run (sumsub-docs-10, sumsub-docs-21). This covers the core of cross-product reuse. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of re-verification or recognizing a returning applicant across sessions within the same product, API/SDK mechanics for triggering reuse, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
